name: dhcping
desc: Perform a dhcp-request to check whether a dhcp-server is running
why: A small probe that sends a DHCP request to see if a server answers, a good door into DHCP that few people ever look through.

brief.what_it_is: dhcping is a small command-line probe from the "Unix -> General Tools" section of Mavetju's personal site. Per the page, it sends a DHCP request to a server and reports whether one answers, which tells you whether a DHCP server is still running. The homepage describes it as "a small tool" that performs a dhcp-request. The page does not say what output it prints or what options it takes.
brief.why_it_exists: The page calls it one of "a random collection of things I've made for myself", so it was written for the author's own use rather than as a product. The stated purpose is to "find out if a dhcp-server is still running".
brief.how_it_works: The homepage gives no mechanism beyond the phrase "perform a dhcp-request". It is a DHCP client-side probe, so it sends a DHCP request and watches for a reply. The page does not explain the packet details, the interface or address options, or the timeout behaviour.
brief.install_notes: Nothing on the homepage about installation, dependencies, or first-run setup. The page links to a man page and a CHANGES file for dhcping v1.2, but I could not get their URLs from the fetched text, so I did not follow them. Homebrew supplies the executable named dhcping.
brief.standout: Few people know this tool exists, which fits the scout note. It is a tiny, single-purpose client that tests a DHCP server from the client side, so it gives a quick liveness check without the server's own tooling. It sits next to the author's ddc (ISC DHCP daemon control) and dhcpdump (DHCP packet parser) in the same family.
brief.status: quiet. The homepage shows dhcping at v1.2 with no release date. The only dated evidence is the page's CVS-style footer, $Id: general.php,v 1.27 2004/07/08, which is from 2004. The page lists an overview of changes, but I could not see its date. I could not confirm current maintenance.
brief.caveats: The homepage is an old personal page with no source repository, licence statement for this tool, or install instructions. It was built for the author's own use and may not reflect current DHCP implementations. Its behaviour against modern servers or IPv6 DHCPv6 is not described. The brew description and the page agree on the purpose.
quotes: A random collection of things I've made for myself.
This small tool let you perform a dhcp-request to find out if a dhcp-server is still running.
For more information, read the man-page.
